remarks: Beautiful original-owner home with numerous upgrades and improvements! Seller is retiring and relocating. This spacious home features high ceilings in the family room, crown molding, marble and laminate flooring, recessed LED lighting, ceiling fans in every room, and a security camera system. The spacious upstairs loft was intentionally designed with an open layout by the builder, offering potential for an additional bedroom or a second primary suite. The home office also offers potential for conversion into an additional bedroom.
